title: a file in a foreign layout that already holds the guard needs no edit, so it is not refused
source: intended: docs/decisions.md D8 (setup hook, defect N-17): jitso registers its guard in the project's .claude/settings.json without clobbering anything
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-17, setup hook). The layout check guards a rewrite. When the guard is already registered, nothing is rewritten, so the answer is `nothing to do` even though the file would not re-encode to its own bytes (the canonical groups with one extra key on a single line). The oracle has no `setup` command: it answers `unknown command "setup"` on stderr with exit 2 and prints nothing on stdout, so every expectation that needs this output or file effect FAILS on it.

stdout: nothing to do (the guard is already registered in .claude/settings.json)
